project.researchNotes:
Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 63 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 23 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

Broad visitor-attraction editorial discovery pass 2026-08-13: expanded See discovery beyond historic records using a local OSM extract. Automatically discovered additions remain below Recommended until source-backed editorial review.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Widnes qualifies as a local detour through Catalyst Museum and Standing cross in St Luke's churchyard, Farnworth, beside the south porch. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Widnes: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Widnes offers Catalyst Museum, Standing cross in St Luke's churchyard, Farnworth, beside the south porch, CHURCH OF ST LUKE within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Catalyst Museum
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Catalyst Museum and Standing cross in St Luke's churchyard, Farnworth, beside the south porch, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Standing cross in St Luke's churchyard, Farnworth, beside the south porch
